Hi Samantha — great talking earlier today. Quick recap and next steps so we keep momentum: 

- What we heard: Finor plans to put a semantic-search + chat assistant in front of internal analytics queries, expected peak traffic around monthly reports and morning ET spikes. Main priorities are predictable p99 latency under 300ms for short queries and cost predictability during batch processing runs.

Next steps I propose:
1) 60-minute combined demo + technical deep dive to show the workflow, discuss model variants, and validate prompt/seq-length assumptions.
2) 45-minute dedicated-capacity sizing call (separate) where Ben (solutions) will walk through throughput/latency sizing and we’ll collect the intake details we need to provision a dedicated GPU pool.

Can you confirm who from your side will join the sizing call (e.g., infra lead, data-platform), and whether you want the sizing call on the same week as the demo or the following week?

Proposed slots (PST):
- Thu Aug 27, 10:00–11:00 
- Thu Aug 27, 15:00–16:00 
- Mon Aug 31, 09:00–10:00

I’ve attached a short sizing intake form — if you can pre-fill the TPS estimates and average prompt/response token lengths ahead of the sizing call, we’ll be able to run a quick back-of-envelope capacity plan before the meeting. 

Attachments: sizing-intake-form.pdf (short), proposed-agenda.md

Thanks — I’ll hold the above slots tentatively for you.

- Marcus

- Attendees for sizing call: myself (product), John Park (infra lead), and Priya Singh (data-platform) — Priya is OOO until Sep 1 but can dial in if needed.
- We’d prefer the demo + tech deep dive this week and the capacity sizing call the week after so Priya can join.

Priya sent over a short workload note earlier today — high-level numbers:
- Typical: ~180 QPS across the cluster during business hours (ET), with 1k QPS burst windows for 10–15 minutes during batch ingest/consolidation.
- Average prompt length: ~70 tokens; typical response length: ~140 tokens.
- Target p95 latency: 120–180ms; p99 target: <= 300ms for short queries.

We can do the demo on Thu Aug 27 at 10:00 PST. For the sizing call, can you suggest 2 slots the week of Sep 1 (PST morning preferred)?

—Sam
